provenance.canonical-source: packages/core/src/checkbox/{Checkbox.tsx,Checkbox.css,CheckboxIcon.tsx,CheckboxIcon.css,CheckboxGroup.tsx,CheckboxGroup.css,internal/useCheckboxGroup.ts,internal/CheckboxGroupContext.ts,index.ts} — the whole component family, seven files. Read for defaults, composition and the documented contract: packages/core/stories/checkbox/{checkbox.stories.tsx,checkbox.qa.stories.tsx}; site/docs/components/checkbox/{index,usage,accessibility,examples}.mdx. Resolution through packages/theme/css/next/characteristics/{selectable,text,status}.css, next/palette/{neutral,accent,negative,warning,background,corner}.css, next/foundations/color.css, packages/theme/css/foundations/{size,spacing,curve,cursor,borderStyle,zindex}.css, next/characteristics/focused.css.
provenance.neutral: CheckboxIcon.css `border-color: var(--salt-selectable-borderColor)` -> next/characteristics/selectable.css:2 `--salt-selectable-borderColor: var(--salt-palette-neutral)` -> next/palette/neutral.css, which declares `--salt-palette-neutral: var(--salt-color-gray-500)` IDENTICALLY under both [data-mode="light"] (line 2) and [data-mode="dark"] (line 13) -> next/foundations/color.css --salt-color-gray-500-rgb: 114, 119, 125. MODE-INVARIANT, the same fact BADGE-MATRIX.md and CHIP-MATRIX.md both recorded for palette-accent — here it is palette-neutral instead, at the SAME two colour stops.
provenance.neutral-fg: CheckboxIcon.css's resting `color` is inherited from `--salt-selectable-foreground` -> next/characteristics/selectable.css:8 `var(--salt-palette-neutral-strong)` -> next/palette/neutral.css, which is NOT mode-invariant: gray-600 rgb(95,100,106) under light (line 5), gray-400 rgb(145,149,154) under dark (line 16) — the resting icon-fill colour genuinely inverts by mode even though the border colour beside it does not.
provenance.accent: CheckboxIcon.css `.saltCheckboxIcon-checked { border-color: var(--salt-selectable-borderColor-selected); color: var(--salt-selectable-foreground-selected) }` -> selectable.css:4,10, BOTH -> `var(--salt-palette-accent)` -> next/palette/accent.css, which declares `--salt-palette-accent: var(--salt-color-blue-500)` identically under [data-mode="light"] (line 2) and [data-mode="dark"] (line 14) -> color.css --salt-color-blue-500-rgb: 0, 120, 207. MODE-INVARIANT. The SAME slot is reused for `-hover`: selectable.css:3 `--salt-selectable-borderColor-hover: var(--salt-palette-accent)` and :9 `--salt-selectable-foreground-hover: var(--salt-palette-accent)` resolve to the IDENTICAL value as `-selected` — hover and selected share one colour, by source, not by this column's simplification. ACCENT SCOPE TRIM: palette-accent has a data-accent axis (blue default, teal alternate); this column pins blue, matching every prior Salt column except calendar.
provenance.box-bg: CheckboxIcon.css `background: var(--salt-container-primary-background)` -> next/characteristics/container.css `--salt-container-primary-background: var(--salt-palette-background-primary)` -> next/palette/background.css, background-snow (light, rgb 255,255,255) / background-jet (dark, rgb 16,24,32). THE FILL NEVER CHANGES ON CHECK — this is the SAME slot used for style.box.rest AND style.box.checked; see state.checked.
provenance.error: CheckboxIcon.css `.saltCheckboxIcon-error { color: var(--salt-status-error-foreground-decorative); border-color: var(--salt-status-error-borderColor) }` -> next/characteristics/status.css:4,15 -> `var(--salt-palette-negative)` -> next/palette/negative.css --salt-palette-negative: var(--salt-color-red-500) -> color.css --salt-color-red-500-rgb: 229, 33, 53. MODE-INVARIANT (negative.css declares the same base stop in both mode blocks; only the -stronger/-weaker steps differ by mode).
provenance.warning: CheckboxIcon.css `.saltCheckboxIcon-warning { color: var(--salt-status-warning-foreground-decorative); border-color: var(--salt-status-warning-borderColor) }` -> status.css -> `var(--salt-palette-warning)` -> next/palette/warning.css --salt-palette-warning: var(--salt-color-orange-500) -> color.css --salt-color-orange-500-rgb: 199, 83, 0. MODE-INVARIANT, same shape as error.
provenance.byDensity.box-size: CheckboxIcon.css `--checkbox-size: var(--salt-size-selectable); width: var(--checkbox-size); height: var(--checkbox-size)` -> foundations/size.css, DENSITY scale: high 12px / medium 14px / low 16px / touch 18px — the SAME token CHIP-MATRIX.md's check-box part cites.
provenance.byDensity.shape-radius: CheckboxIcon.css `border-radius: var(--salt-palette-corner-weaker, 0)` -> next/palette/corner.css `--salt-palette-corner-weaker: var(--salt-curve-50)` -> foundations/curve.css, DENSITY scale: 1/2/3/4px (high/medium/low/touch) — the exact token CHIP-MATRIX.md finding-1 used to show Salt's Pill is 'nearly square'; under [data-corner="sharp"] this collapses to curve-0 = 0px (corner.css line 10), the identical edition trap.
provenance.byDensity.root-gap: Checkbox.css `.saltCheckbox { gap: var(--salt-spacing-100) }` -> foundations/spacing.css, DENSITY scale: 4/8/12/16px (high/medium/low/touch) — the box-to-label gap.
provenance.byDensity.type-fontSize / type-lineHeigh: Checkbox.css `.saltCheckbox { font-size: var(--salt-text-fontSize); line-height: var(--salt-text-lineHeight); font-family: var(--salt-text-fontFamily); font-weight: var(--salt-text-fontWeight) }` -> next/characteristics/text.css, the BODY role (not text-notation, which badge and chip both used) -> DENSITY scale 11/14 . 12/16 . 14/18 . 16/20px (high/medium/low/touch), matching docs/foundations/typography.md's body row. `--salt-text-fontWeight: var(--salt-typography-fontWeight-regular)` (text.css:9) = 400 — REGULAR, unlike badge's SEMIBOLD text-notation role.
provenance.border-width-fixed: CheckboxIcon.css `border: var(--salt-size-fixed-100) ...` -> foundations/size.css --salt-size-fixed-100: 1px, on the FIXED (density-invariant) scale by design, carried as a plain literal rather than a slot, the same call CHIP-MATRIX.md finding-11 made for the identical token.
provenance.focus-outline: Checkbox.css `.saltCheckbox-input:focus-visible + .saltCheckboxIcon { outline: var(--saltCheckbox-outline, var(--salt-focused-outline)); outline-offset: var(--salt-spacing-fixed-100) }` -> next/characteristics/focused.css: `--salt-focused-outline: 2px dotted var(--salt-focused-outlineColor)`, `--salt-focused-outlineColor: var(--salt-palette-accent-stronger)` -> palette/accent.css --salt-color-blue-700-rgb: 0, 69, 126 (light) / --salt-color-blue-300-rgb: 154, 189, 245 (dark, since accent-stronger is NOT the mode-invariant base stop) -> outline-offset foundations/spacing.css --salt-spacing-fixed-100: 1px, FIXED scale.
provenance.no-pressed-state: CONFIRMED ABSENCE, checked directly: neither Checkbox.css nor CheckboxIcon.css contains any `:active` selector.
provenance.no-transition: CONFIRMED ABSENCE: neither Checkbox.css nor CheckboxIcon.css declares a `transition` property anywhere.
provenance.readonly-not-modelled: Salt's readOnly visual (a dashed border via `--salt-borderStyle-dashed` and a lighter `CheckmarkIcon` glyph swapped for `CheckmarkSolidIcon`, CheckboxIcon.css `.saltCheckboxIcon-readOnly`) is sourced [S] but NOT expanded into its own style row for scope — see the matrix doc's 'Declared approximations'.
provenance.no-success-styling: Checkbox.tsx's own JSDoc on `validationStatus`: 'No visual styling will be applied on "success" variant' — a capability the TYPE permits (AdornmentValidationStatus includes 'success') that the CSS never expresses, so prop.validation's Salt value list omits it (CHIP-MATRIX finding-2's class of defect, avoided here by reading the type AND the CSS together rather than the type alone).

structure.shell.source: Checkbox.tsx returns <label className=saltCheckbox>{input}{CheckboxIcon}{label}</label> — one real <label>, three children

structure.native-input.source: Checkbox.tsx <input type="checkbox" ... /> — a real native input, opacity:0, position:absolute (Checkbox.css)

structure.outline-layer.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — CheckboxIcon.css puts border, background and icon all on the ONE .saltCheckboxIcon element; no separate outline/fill layer exists

structure.mark.source: CheckboxIcon.tsx: CheckmarkSolidIcon (checked, not readOnly) or CheckmarkIcon (checked, readOnly) svg; CheckboxIcon.css `.saltCheckboxIcon-indeterminate::before` draws the dash as a plain CSS bar, not an svg

structure.group.source: CheckboxGroup.tsx renders a <fieldset> providing disabled/readOnly/validationStatus/name/checkedValues via CheckboxGroupContext; no keydown handler anywhere in useCheckboxGroup.ts/CheckboxGroupContext.ts

behavior.role.value: implicit — role=checkbox from the native <input type="checkbox">, no explicit role attribute anywhere
behavior.role.source: Checkbox.tsx — no role prop, no aria-* beyond aria-describedby/aria-labelledby/aria-readonly

behavior.keyboard-activation.source: accessibility.mdx: 'Space changes the state of the checkbox, select or deselect'; no onKeyDown in Checkbox.tsx

behavior.label-click-target.value: the WHOLE label — box and text both toggle it

behavior.tri-state.value: native — a click/space always resolves to checked and clears indeterminate
behavior.tri-state.source: handleChange reads event.target.checked post-toggle; a useIsomorphicLayoutEffect syncs inputRef.current.indeterminate = indeterminate ?? false reactively, because `indeterminate` has no HTML attribute form

behavior.group-navigation.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — useCheckboxGroup.ts and CheckboxGroupContext.ts bind no keydown handler; every checkbox keeps its own tab stop, Tab/Shift+Tab only (accessibility.mdx)

behavior.validation.value: computed in JS and SUPPRESSED when disabled

behavior.disabled-handling.value: native `disabled` on the input (ORed with the group's), plus a blanket opacity class on the whole label
behavior.disabled-handling.source: Checkbox.tsx `const disabled = checkboxGroup?.disabled || formFieldDisabled || disabledProp`; Checkbox.css `.saltCheckbox-disabled { opacity: 0.4 }`

behavior.readonly.value: implemented in JS, NOT relying on the (spec-inert) native readonly attribute
behavior.readonly.source: Checkbox.tsx handleChange: `if (event.nativeEvent.defaultPrevented || readOnly) { return }`; also passes readOnly/aria-readonly to the input and swaps the checkmark glyph + border style (CheckboxIcon.tsx/.css)

behavior.form-participation.value: native — the input IS the real form control
behavior.form-participation.source: a real <input type="checkbox" name=... value=... checked=.../>, no custom validity machinery needed

prop.value-shape.source: CheckboxProps: `checked?: boolean; defaultChecked?: boolean; indeterminate?: boolean` — two independent optional booleans

prop.validation.source: CheckboxProps.validationStatus?: AdornmentValidationStatus, undefined/off by default (SOURCE-DEFAULT-FIRST); 'success' is typed but produces no CSS (see no-success-styling), so it is not listed as a value here

prop.disabled.source: CheckboxProps.disabled?: boolean, ORed with the group's

prop.read-only.source: CheckboxProps.readOnly?: boolean (via the omitted InputHTMLAttributes base, re-destructured explicitly as readOnlyProp)

prop.required.note: reachable only via `inputProps.required` (CheckboxProps has no top-level `required` — its base type omits attributes not valid on a <label>), a more indirect API shape than M3's first-class reflected property

slot.label.value: label?: ReactNode, rendered as the LAST child inside the component's own <label>

slot.composes.note: form-field (useFormFieldProps() pulls aria-describedby/aria-labelledby/disabled/readOnly/validationStatus down from an ancestor <FormField> when NOT inside a CheckboxGroup — Checkbox.tsx lines 148-163), and radio-button (the explicitly-excluded mutually-exclusive sibling, usage.mdx)

state.rest.value: neutral gray-500 outline (mode-invariant) on a white/near-black container fill, never filled solid
state.rest.note: an outline-style box at EVERY state, including checked — see state.checked

state.checked.value: the fill NEVER changes — only the outline and icon recolour to accent blue
state.checked.note: confirmed: no background rule anywhere keys off checked in CheckboxIcon.css

state.indeterminate.value: RESETS to the plain neutral colours, even when checked is also true
state.indeterminate.source: CheckboxIcon.css `.saltCheckboxIcon-checked.saltCheckboxIcon-indeterminate { border-color: var(--salt-selectable-borderColor); color: var(--salt-selectable-foreground) }` — the compound selector overrides back to neutral

state.hover.value: border and icon recolour to the -hover variant of whichever base they were already on; the root's :hover, not the input's

state.focus.value: 2px dotted accent-stronger outline at 1px offset, plus the hover recolour riding along

state.disabled.value: blanket opacity 0.4 (a literal) on the whole label, plus not-allowed cursor

style.box.border-width.source: CheckboxIcon.css border: var(--salt-size-fixed-100) solid ... = 1px, FIXED scale

style.icon.size.source: CheckboxIcon.css --saltIcon-size: 100% — the Icon component's own default, fills whatever box it sits in

style.root.font.source: Checkbox.css .saltCheckbox { font-size/line-height/font-family/font-weight: var(--salt-text-*) } — the BODY role, REGULAR (400), not text-notation

style.box.rest.source: CheckboxIcon.css .saltCheckboxIcon { border-color: selectable-borderColor; background: container-primary-background; color: selectable-foreground }

style.box.checked.source: CheckboxIcon.css .saltCheckboxIcon-checked { border-color: selectable-borderColor-selected; color: selectable-foreground-selected } — no background rule; box-bg is UNCHANGED from rest, repeated here deliberately so the 'fill never changes' finding is visible in the generated CSS rather than merely asserted

style.box.indeterminate.source: CheckboxIcon.css .saltCheckboxIcon-checked.saltCheckboxIcon-indeterminate resets border-color/color BACK to the plain (non-selected) selectable tokens — byte-identical to style.box.rest, which IS the finding

style.box.hover.source: CheckboxIcon.css `.saltCheckbox:hover .saltCheckboxIcon, .saltCheckbox:hover .saltCheckboxIcon-indeterminate { border-color: selectable-borderColor-hover; color: selectable-foreground-hover }` — both resolve to the SAME accent slot as -selected (see provenance)

style.box.validation.source: CheckboxIcon.css .saltCheckboxIcon-error { color: status-error-foreground-decorative; border-color: status-error-borderColor }; Checkbox.css .saltCheckbox-error ...:focus-visible sets outline-color to the same

style.box.transition.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no transition property anywhere in Checkbox.css or CheckboxIcon.css

style.box.state-layer.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — Salt has no ripple/state-layer concept for checkbox; hover and focus recolour the box directly

style.mark.short-size.note: markStyle=svg-plus-pseudo-dash — no <rect> in this strategy, see structure.mark
